Eliud Kipchoge Wins Melbourne Marathon, Sets New Record

Kenyan runner Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon, his first marathon victory in three years. The 41-year-old athlete also broke the marathon's record by two seconds. Kipchoge expressed his satisfaction with his performance, stating he is still at his peak and happy to compete with younger generations.
